n: G'day legends! Meet Alex, an Aussie operative bluffing into a scam center with a fake lanyard and rubber chicken!
Under the alias Gary Windows, he hacks the central server while absolute slapstick mayhem erupts around him!
Alex breezes past the gullible guard using the ultimate unhackable password: Password123. Absolute genius, mate!
A rogue pigeon invades the terminal, furiously playing Minesweeper across forty-seven screens as the ultimate cover!
Cornered mid-hack, Alex flashes his squeaky rubber chicken and claims it’s high-tech security gear!
The feather-brained pigeon trips the fire alarm, triggering a glorious chain reaction of chai spills and tumbling scammers!
From a squalid hotel, Alex dumps syndicate data onto a fluffy pink cat USB drive like a legend.
He recruits local cops and the Grey Avengers—a ruthless squad of pensioners armed with overripe tomatoes!
The raid kicks off with absolute chaos as a pensioner accidentally snipes an inspector with squishy fruit!
An old lady pulls the fire alarm before a massive explosion rocks the entire villain hideout!
Next, Alex's crew infiltrates a high-tech wellness sanctuary disguised as ridiculous spiritual auditors!
They prove their authority when their enforcer smashes an eighty-thousand-dollar sculpture to fix negative juju!
The team stages a phony exorcism, convincing the paranoid mark to surrender a diamond-encrusted pen as ghost bait!
Freezing mist rolls in as they seal the imaginary financial demon right inside a dented thermos!
Back in Kolkata, Alex finds gold: a video of syndicate boss Big Rakesh trying to socially engineer a toaster!
Alex pitches Interpol officials using the toaster footage and flies the senior army straight to India!
The seniors go rogue immediately, gearing up with tactical duck calls, gravy pistols, and revenge tomatoes!
A near-blind getaway driver rolls their clunking florist van right up to the syndicate’s main gates!
Covered in tomato pulp, Alex watches a smug pigeon pull a victory barrel-roll and land on his shoulder!
When news crews flock, Alex deadpans "rubber chicken" straight into the mic while the pigeon coos with authority!
The street erupts into a crazy Bollywood party with cartwheeling retirees tumbling into decorative ferns!
Police formally award Alex a gold-plated pigeon pin for cyber bravery, pinning it on his tomato-stained shirt!
Among the crimson aftermath, an old vigilante proudly adopts a pristine souvenir fruit named Terry!
Back at his hotel, the relentless pigeon struts into Alex's room like an arrogant, feathered landlord!
Reunited with neon hacker Juzzie, Alex uses a stolen toilet-paper complaint login to launch a global cyber-strike!
Touching down in Brisbane, border security recognizes the famous celebrity pigeon riding on Alex's shoulder!
The bird delivers an Oscar-worthy coo, emotionally manipulating customs into approving it as a registered support animal!
Alex gets ambushed at home by retirees, led by Barry brandishing a ceremonial tomato for a hero's welcome!
At Redcliffe Community Hall, Alex obliterates a cardboard scam-boss effigy with a lethal tomato throw!
Plaque in hand and bird on shoulder, Gary Windows stands ready to scam scammers everywhere, Juzzy style!
